name: EMA Stack v2
description: Three EMAs with stack-order classification and cross triggers. Fixes the built-in ema_stack's hardcoded period bug — uses the user's actual short/mid/long params.
author: user

output_descriptions.SML: Short > Mid > Long — full bullish stack
output_descriptions.SLM: Short > Long > Mid — short leading, mid dipped
output_descriptions.MSL: Mid > Short > Long — mid leading, short pulling back
output_descriptions.MLS: Mid > Long > Short — mid leading, bearish short
output_descriptions.LSM: Long > Short > Mid — long on top, transitional
output_descriptions.LMS: Long > Mid > Short — full bearish stack

cross_bull.reason: indicator_vs_indicator (short EMA vs mid EMA) — Phase 2

cross_bear.reason: indicator_vs_indicator (short EMA vs mid EMA) — Phase 2

mid_cross_bull.reason: indicator_vs_indicator (mid EMA vs long EMA) — Phase 2

mid_cross_bear.reason: indicator_vs_indicator (mid EMA vs long EMA) — Phase 2
